witnesses.provenance: Solana's per-transaction MAX_COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT is 1,400,000 compute units. It is the chain's limit, not ours. The campaign sets ProgramTest's ceiling to exactly that value and never raises it, so a transaction that did not fit would fail rather than be re-run with headroom. Note the direction of this witness: it is a chain limit the campaign must live under, not a measurement of ours restated as a target.

Solana's MAX_INSTRUCTION_STACK_DEPTH is 5, counting the top-level instruction as depth 1, so the deepest admissible `invoke [n]` line any program can produce is [5]. The Series occurrence chain runs caller -> Core -> role artifact, and this witness is what would catch a composition change that quietly added a CPI level and put the route one hop from the runtime's hard stop.

witnesses.query: [.transactions[] | select(.error != null) | select([.logs[] | select(contains("custom program error: 0x"))] | length > 0)] | length | tostring
witnesses.provenance: The Solana runtime reports a privilege, frame, or account refusal it decides ITSELF as a bare InstructionError with no `custom program error:` log line; that line appears only when a program returned ProgramError::Custom. TIERS.md draws exactly this distinction and records a pre-taxonomy refusal as an unnamed one, because crediting it would overstate what the program proved. This witness is the campaign's claim that both of its hostile cases were decided by a dClutch program rather than bounced by the runtime -- which is what makes naming a refusal code admissible at all.

witnesses.expect: Series occurrence Consume founds its Market with a Core permit
witnesses.provenance: A route is EXECUTED in this census only on a succeeding transaction, and a campaign that accidentally accepted one of its own hostile cases would flip a row on the strength of a bug. This witness pins which single transaction is allowed to succeed, so a future change that weakened either refusal fails the tier instead of silently improving its coverage numbers. The rule it encodes is AGENTS.md's: do not weaken a refusal to make an integration test pass.
